data.name: Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm
data.detailed_description:
For years, Lisa has been haunted by recurring nightmares of a burning mansion.
One sleepless night, while watching a television documentary about abandoned places and local legends,
she recognizes the very same mansion from her dreams. Determined to uncover the truth behind
these disturbing visions, she sets out to investigate the mysterious property for herself.

Her search leads her to the old mansion at the end of Pineview Drive. Standing abandoned for
decades near the small fishing village of Lakeview Bay, the mansion has become the subject of countless rumors
and local legends. Even today, the people of the region avoid speaking about the place and its troubled past.

Old records tell of a mysterious cycle that once plagued the area. For many years,
a violent storm would sweep across the region for exactly thirty days. During this time,
people reported strange apparitions, unexplained phenomena, and even mysterious disappearances.
Many believed that the old mansion was somehow connected to these terrifying events.

Determined to find answers, Lisa begins exploring the mansion and its surroundings.
What starts as a search for the origins of her nightmares soon turns into a terrifying journey
into the dark history of Pineview Drive, where every discovery reveals another piece of a long-forgotten mystery.
As the storm outside continues to rise, so does the turmoil within her mind, blurring the line between memory, nightmare and reality.

Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm is the official sequel to the 2014 horror adventure Pineview Drive and,
for the first time, reveals the story behind the old mansion and the events that have haunted this place for decades.

Features:
---------

- Explore the Old Mansion and the Coastal Region
Explore the old mansion at the end of Pineview Drive and the mysterious coastal region surrounding Lakeview Bay.
Discover new locations, unlock hidden paths and delve deeper into a mystery that has remained buried for decades.

- Uncover the Dark History of Pineview Drive
Collect clues, documents and records to piece together the mansion's past.
Learn more about the legends surrounding the mysterious cycle, the disappearances
and the events that have shaped this place for decades.

- Solve Classic Adventure Puzzles
The old mansion is filled with hidden mechanisms and secrets.
Solve a variety of puzzles, discover concealed devices and gradually unlock new areas of the estate.
Observation and clever thinking are often more valuable than brute force.

- Survive the Horrors of the Night
As the storm continues to grow stronger, the dark secrets of Pineview Drive begin to awaken once again.
Use a variety of tools and weapons to keep supernatural manifestations at bay, and decide for yourself when to fight, hide or flee in order to survive.

- Adaptive Horror That Responds to Your Playstyle
The unique Fear Factor system analyzes your behavior and dynamically adjusts the intensity,
frequency and type of scare events throughout the game. This creates a personalized tension curve for every player,
resulting in a horror experience that adapts to the way you play.

- Atmosphere That Gets Under Your Skin
A unique combination of music, ambient sounds and dynamic audio effects creates an exceptionally
dense horror atmosphere. Every location, every encounter and every moment is accompanied by a haunting
soundscape that steadily builds tension and unease, making Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm an intense psychological horror experience.

- Some Nightmares Never Die
Players familiar with the original Pineview Drive may recognize certain horrors lurking in the shadows.
Some nightmares have been waiting for your return.


Real horror has many faces, but only one address: Pineview Drive.

data.short_description: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.
data.supported_languages:
English*, German*, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ (64-bit only)
  • Processor: 64-bit Intel Core i5 (6th gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU supporting DirectX 11+ 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ (64-bit only)
  • Processor: 64-bit Intel Core i5 (6th gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 4080 or similar with 16 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible
